name: badge
useFor: Use chip for a plan tag, a count or an endpoint (Every merchant, POST /buy). Use the status pills for an order or route (Processing, then Confirmed in brand). Use tag, tag-ink and tag-heart for added, improved and fixed updates.
constraints: More than one tone per row
source: opencommerce-agentcard-web src/components/pricing.tsx (the plan chip), features.tsx and globals.css (.feat-pill, .feat-pill-wait, .feat-pill-done)

examples.content:
import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge"; export function Site() { return (
Every merchant 4000+ stores POST /buy
Processing Confirmed Operational Degraded Down
Added Improved Fixed
); }

title: Badge
description: Mono chips for counts and tags, small pills for an order or route status.
